scope: Actual generated raw motion was decoded and inspected across every frame; independent action feasibility pass only. Not a full-film, musical phrasing, publication-polish, gait, or mass-production approval.

method.honesty_limit: Browser ran actual complete take at1x with no seeking, errors, dropped or corrupted frames. This verifies playback delivery; reviewer visual judgment used ordered decoded-frame evidence, not a claim of human-equivalent continuous video perception. Source is silent; no original song listened to in this diagnostic.

observed.initial_support: Giver alone supports one box, receiver hands separated and empty. Receiver approaches under box before weight transfer.
observed.receiver_contact: Visible contact begins approximately0.7–1.0s, followed by sustained shared support as box travels toward receiver.
observed.after: Receiver alone supports the same box against her torso; giver both hands lowered. Subtle worried gaze/head settling follows.
observed.identity_props_room: Two coherent identities and wardrobes persist. One box, upright ordered record sleeves/red-circle cover, empty shelf, lamp and doorway remain. Rotation changes box perspective plausibly; no gross box collapse, duplicate prop, free-floating interval or ownership reversal found.
observed.specific_limits: The closer framing makes both approach and release easy to read. Giver first opens the near hand, then withdraws the far hand while receiver already cups the box underside. A short blur/softening occurs around frames80–82 during hand withdrawal; it does not become an enduring third limb or unsupported box. Feet are outside this intentional medium framing, so this take cannot prove planted-foot mechanics.

usable_diagnostic_source_range.editorial_limit: This range contains approach/contact/transfer/release/result, but opening-shot musical timing and full-film cut are still root/editor review decisions. Choose one coverage rather than play both alternative handoffs.

remaining_gates: Raw hand softness must be judged at intended final display scale; no blanket claim of perfect anatomy.
Close-up and wide are alternatives, not two repeated story actions.
Chair rise, meaningful gait and coat donning are different mechanics and remain separate pilot gates.
No full49 production until story/animatic and actual motion gates pass.
